notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is missing or incorrect for return-trip tickets in Mozio email confirmations. The map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch mapper carries discount data per dispatch, and create-reservations.mappers has return-trip-specific logic (station swap). The discount amount likely needs analogous return-trip handling so it appears in the Mozio confirmation for return tickets.

notes: Openspec provided no acceptance criteria (empty array), only a descriptive note about the defect. I created all ACs from scratch based on the defect description and the listed technical files. AC-1 is the core fix verification. AC-2 ensures no regression on outbound trips. AC-3 covers the no-discount edge case. AC-4 covers the case where outbound and return discounts differ (prevents a naive copy of outbound discount to return). AC-5 and AC-6 trace the discount data through the mapper and webhook paths identified in the technical notes to ensure the fix is end-to-end. AC-7 covers the zero-discount edge case.
